name: Battle

components.pose: She stands with her alembic staff in one hand and flings a glowing flask with the other, her half-cape swirling, a sly, fierce gaze straight to the camera; full figure visible.
components.effects: A flask bursts into a billowing cloud of luminous {{MAGIC}} venom mist rolling across the field, glowing droplets hanging in the air, burst vats hissing behind her.

notes: BATTLE: the sister in class-aligned war gear commanding her element on a battlefield of her homeland. Reuses her signature weapon.
